verdicts.reason: Quotes are accurate but the inference is not. 11.02.01:79-80 states one-stop is 'true **only when** the combined verdict is `clearable-now` **and** the buyer transacts with exactly one counterparty', and :97 repeats 'displayed **only if**' — these are NECESSARY conditions, not an iff. Nothing in 11.02.01 licenses an implementer to treat the five verdict inputs as sufficient for the one-stop boolean. The additional necessary condition is owned by the file 11.02.01:54 delegates input 3 to: 11.02.03:207 D-02 'Silence is not cleanliness — an undeclared work is not one-stop', with the exact user-facing behaviour specified at 11.02.03:126 ('No sample declaration — this work can't be one-stop. [Declare]') and 11.02.03:158. The claimed-unspecified verdict value is specified by the same rows: the verdict is unaffected (no encumbrance ⇒ no `encumbered`), only the one-stop badge is withheld, and there is deliberately no issuance gate — 11.05.01:235 D-02 'No hard gate on release for missing declarations … a gate manufactures documented lies'. The sub-domain CX answers it a second time, unmarked and definitively, at 11.02-clearance-one-stop-status-cx.md:79: 'Both fire on session close (domain 07). If either is skipped, the work is not one-stop — which is the *correct* default and the honest one.' An implementer building input 3 must open 11.02.03 and meets D-02 there.

The tension is real and is explicitly the subject of a live, owned, targeted open question in the very file that carries D-10. 11.02.01:213 Q-06: 'Is the platform the single counterparty (a licensing principal/agent) or a directory that publishes verdicts? Per DT-06, a multi-party work is functionally one-stop **only** if the platform issues, collects and splits … **This decides whether D-10 leaves the badge almost always false**' — Owner: User, Deferred To: `/create-prd-security` (business model + legal). Under the principal branch a four-writer work IS exactly one counterparty and every 11.02.02 string is consistent with D-10; under the directory branch the strings need rewriting, which Q-06 says in terms ('the domain rationale's central claim needs rewriting'). The finding's counting argument also conflates two distinct quantities: 11.02.02:83's denominator is 'distinct human identities on the attested list', whereas D-07 (11.02.01:193) defines the counterparty set as the consent graph in which 'administered shares resolve to the administrator' — four listed writers under one administrator are four named parties and one counterparty. 11.02.02 additionally defers rather than competes: :121 'Clearance recomputes → the work **can become** one-stop for scopes that permit it', consuming 11.02.01's determination rather than restating a rule for it.

Quotes verified verbatim (11.01.04:53, :54, :92, Q-01/02/03 at :99-101). But the domain CX unifies this exact requirement across features and supplies the cadence: music-licensing-cx.md:227-238 pattern P-01 'Perishable state must warn its owner, not only its counterparty' lists **11.01.04 DT-02** as its first instance alongside 'CX-21 — a lapsing clearance re-encumbers a work with no user action; **warn at 90/30/7 days**', and concludes 'A supply-side lesson … generated the same requirement in four features with nothing else in common. **State it once at platform level.**' The lead time is therefore one platform-level value, not four per-feature inventions. The domain also has an explicit convention routing this class of number downstream, stated in the nearest analogous feature: 11.02.04:60 '`[PENDING — exact window and reminder cadence to /write-be-spec; the default must never round down to "silence = yes" per D-03]`' — which also supplies the solicitation-timeout default the finding says is missing (14 days, chase reminders at day 3 and day 7) for the same multi-party solicitation 11.01.04:41 routes through. Finally, 11.01.04 is `[SURFACE]` status (11.01-sync-licensing-index.md:28), not `[DEEP]`; a tunable constant absent from a SURFACE node is its declared depth, not a gap. The normative behaviour (warn both sides before, never after, never silent) is fully fixed — only a configuration constant is open.

Quotes verified verbatim (11.08.04:58, :34-36, :103, Q-01..Q-03 at :111-113). Same refutation as #003 and from the same source: music-licensing-cx.md:227-238 P-01 names **11.08.04 DT-02** explicitly — 'an unattended licence expiry is a renewal the owner never knew was available' — as one of four instances of one requirement, pairs the cluster with CX-21's 'warn at 90/30/7 days' (also at music-licensing-cx.md:176 'term reaches T-90/T-30/T-7 → warn owner'), and rules 'State it once at platform level.' The cadence for perishable-state warnings in this domain is therefore established and shared, not absent; 11.08.04's 'T-minus-N' is the local reference to it. The finding's own failure scenario ('Implementer A adopts the domain's clearance-lapse cadence 90/30/7') is the reading P-01 mandates. 11.08.04 is also `[PARTIAL]` status (11.08-licence-instrument-lifecycle-index.md:30, file header :5), with the normative content — automatic, unattended, warns both sides, D-03 — fully specified; only a constant is open, and 11.02.04:60 records the domain's convention of routing exact windows and reminder cadences to `/write-be-spec`.

All three statements hold simultaneously; the finding reads D-03 too broadly and omits the resolution of Q-01. 11.11:91 D-03 rejects grand rights as 'a scope-grammar **media value**' — not as a grammar entry, and R-05 (music-licensing-cx.md:288) is titled '11.08.01 Scope Grammar (**as a media value**)'. 11.11:98 Q-01 is RESOLVED and states the opposite of the finding's premise: 'a `wont` band removes the product and **leaves the grammar entry intact**' — the taxonomy key space exists. The grammar already demonstrates the mechanism for a category that must never be implied by a media grant: 11.08.01:48 adds a separate **Data use** axis precisely so AI training is 'Separate from media by construction … **Never implied by any media grant, however broad**' — nine axes, not the six the finding assumes. The enforcement point is also present and needs no new bar: 11.11:40 happy path step 3 'Bespoke negotiation (11.03.02) — **no cards, no auto-approve**'; and because a dramatic request is not a point in the auto-approvable space, 11.04.01:57 ('An unset axis never auto-approves … A request with an unset axis falls through') plus 11.02.01:200 D-14 (no scope, no verdict) and :127 (unknown axis values are 'Rejected. **Never coerced to the nearest known value**') already exclude it. The residual case the finding invents — a theatre mis-declaring dramatic use as 'film' — is buyer misdeclaration, handled as a warranty/liability question at 11.04.02:259 Q-06, not a spec contradiction. 11.11 is `[SURFACE]` with the product banded WONT.

Both halves fail on the file. (1) CX-16 is not stale — it is verifiably still owed. 11.04.01 is dated 2026-07-23 (:6, the same date as 11.04.02) and its Behavior still reads, uncorrected, at :30-31: 'A policy attaches to a party's share of a work … **Its key space is the licence scope grammar (11.08.01)**: media, territory, term, exclusivity, usage, scale, plus a value threshold'. music-licensing-cx.md:148-149 says precisely this: 'This is a **correction owed on the 11.04.01 text**, not a design gap — but it must be written down or two files contradict.' 11.04.02:66-70 writing the correction into ITS OWN file does not discharge a correction owed on 11.04.01's text; the CX row is accurate as written. P-04 is also a tracked routing with an explicit target ('Routed to `/create-prd-architecture`', :276) and is cross-referenced from R-04 (:287); what 11.04.02 D-12 settles is the per-category **default** (product), while what P-04 routes is whether one refusal **engine** serves all three key spaces (architecture) — different objects, no duplication forced.

The 11.07.03:57 quote is verbatim, but the finding's enumeration of the file's Open Questions is incomplete and omits the row that covers it. 11.07.03:103 Q-03: '**Is "my work is in this model" a credit rather than a payment?** Per DT-02 this sub-domain's value is evidentiary, and domain 02 owns evidentiary claims about work. This feature may be in the wrong domain — **or may be two things, a credit in 02 and a payment here**. … A component-boundary call between 02 and 11.' — Owner: **Agent**, Deferred To: **`/create-prd-architecture`**. 'Rights holder wants attribution but not money' is exactly the attribution-without-payment axis Q-03 owns, with a live owner and a live target; the stale `[PENDING — /ideate-discover Step 5 deepening]` marker on the edge-case row is residue over a question the file already tracks properly. 11.07.03:85 restates the same routing in the Cross-Cut Notes: '"my work is in this model" is arguably a **credit**, not a payment … that may be this feature's real home — see Q-03.' Both of the finding's divergent implementers are also constrained by D-01/D-04, and the row's own text ('unsupported by a payment-shaped feature') states the current behaviour: the feature pays; the attribution-only variant is Q-03's to place.

The marker at 11.02-clearance-one-stop-status-cx.md:82 is verbatim as quoted, but it is stale residue over a question the tree has since decided in three places — so there is no gap for a later stage to receive. The same CX file answers it three lines earlier, unmarked and unconditionally, at :79: 'Both fire on session close (domain 07). **If either is skipped, the work is not one-stop** — which is the *correct* default and the honest one.' It is then ratified as a standing decision in the file that owns the fact, dated 2026-07-23 (post-deepening): 11.02.03:207 D-02 'Silence is not cleanliness — **an undeclared work is not one-stop**', with the state and user-facing copy specified at 11.02.03:126 and :158. 11.05.01:238 D-05 supplies the matching declaration-side rule ('only the latter can support one-stop') and 11.05.01:187 the distinct state. The provisional answer the row carries ('both required') is the answer that was adopted, not an unadopted guess — so the stale marker costs nothing downstream. Because the underlying question is settled, the tracking-hygiene claim ('no later stage will receive it') describes a marker with nothing left to carry, and the divergence it is said to leave open (finding #001) does not exist.
